name: Thomas Alva Edison
summary: Prolific American inventor known for the phonograph, incandescent light bulb, and electric power distribution systems.

portrait.artist: Louis Bachrach, Bachrach Studios, restored by Michel Vuijlsteke

name: Milan, Ohio
summary: Village in Ohio where Thomas Edison was born.

name: Port Huron, Michigan
summary: City in Michigan where the Edison family moved in 1854.

name: Menlo Park, New Jersey
summary: Location in Middlesex County, New Jersey, where Edison built his first industrial laboratory.

name: Edison Laboratory
summary: World's first industrial laboratory designed and built by Edison.

name: Edison Electric Light Company
summary: Company formed in New York City to develop Edison's lighting systems.

name: Edison Illuminating Company
summary: Company founded to commercially distribute electric utility.

name: General Electric
summary: Company formed by the merger of Edison General Electric and Thomson-Houston.

name: Western Union
summary: Telegraph company where Edison worked as an employee of the Associated Press bureau.

name: Clarence Dally
summary: Edison's laboratory assistant and the first radiation martyr.

name: Mary Stillwell
summary: Edison's first wife.

name: Mina Miller
summary: Edison's second wife, daughter of inventor Lewis Miller.

name: Phonograph
summary: Device invented by Edison for recording and playing sound.

name: Incandescent lamp
summary: Commercially practical electric light using a carbon filament.

name: Edison Fluoroscope
summary: Device for viewing X-ray images developed by Edison.

name: Kinetograph
summary: Motion picture camera patented by Edison.

name: Fort Myers, Florida
summary: Location of Edison's winter retreat where he died.

name: Naval Consulting Board
summary: US government advisory board headed by Edison during World War I.

name: US Patent 90,646
summary: Edison's first patent for an electric vote recorder.

name: US Patent 222,390
summary: Patent for carbon telephones.

name: US Patent 223,898
summary: Patent for an electric lamp using a carbon filament.

name: Edison Portland Cement Company
summary: Company founded by Edison to promote cement use.
